rubric.role_summary: Design verification engineer for physics-inspired ASICs, owning verification through tapeout and reviewing AI-generated verification collateral and training examples. The role may also support customer deployments.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Design verification engineer for physics-inspired ASICs, owning verification through tapeout and reviewing AI-generated verification collateral and training examples. The role may also support customer deployments.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 5+ years of experience in digital verification at a semiconductor or EDA tool company.
- Proficiency in SystemVerilog and UVM for design verification.
- Proven end-to-end design verification expertise, including test plan creation, stimulus generation, and feature extraction.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Experience in a customer-facing, field-application, or forward-deployed engineering role at a semiconductor or EDA company.
- Hands-on use of LLMs or agentic tools in verification workflows.
- Exposure to analog, mixed-signal, or unconventional compute verification.
- Advanced proficiency in SystemVerilog, UVM methodology, and EDA verification tools, with strong Python or Perl scripting. The named EDA tools are examples, not an all-tools requirement.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): New York metropolitan area; Greater London, United Kingdom area; San Francisco Bay Area, California. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Hybrid work is based in one of these areas.
